claim: The motivation loop CLOSES: an unknown becomes a ranked frontier pursuit, acting on it moves the underlying belief, and the moved belief changes the ranking on the next pass. The decision is deterministic — the same self state yields the same ranking, with no RNG anywhere in it.
hypothesis: If the loop were open, resolving an unknown would leave the frontier unchanged and the substrate would keep pursuing what it had already learned.

metrics.name: evidence_quality
metrics.note: UniversalDomainMaster.COMPETENCE_EVIDENCE_QUALITY — the real, deliberately low production default, not a test value

metrics.name: cycles_to_competence
metrics.note: weak positive evidence updates needed before the gap left the unstable set; 1 would mean competence flips on a single point

metrics.name: entropy_pursued_after
metrics.note: must fall below the 0.7 unstable threshold for the gap to close

metrics.name: entropy_reduction
metrics.note: how far acting on the pursuit moved the belief

metrics.name: entropy_untouched_control
metrics.note: the OTHER unknown, which must not move — proves the update was targeted rather than a global drift toward confidence

metrics.name: pursuits_before
metrics.note: frontier size while both seeded unknowns are still unknown

metrics.name: pursuits_after
metrics.note: frontier size after one is RESOLVED — the loop closing shows here
